name: Workspace ONE UEM MCP Server
description: Enables AI assistants to interact with VMware Workspace ONE UEM environments for device management, user administration, and system operations. Provides access to 25+ commonly used UEM APIs with support for OAuth2 authentication and bulk operations.

rawRecord.description: Enables AI assistants to interact with VMware Workspace ONE UEM environments for device management, user administration, and system operations. Provides access to 25+ commonly used UEM APIs with support for OAuth2 authentication and bulk operations.

WS1_UEM_API_KEY.description: Your API key (also called Tenant Code) from Workspace ONE UEM

WS1_UEM_BASE_URL.description: The base URL of your Workspace ONE UEM instance (e.g., https://your-instance.awmdm.com)

WS1_UEM_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth client ID for OAuth authentication

WS1_UEM_TOKEN_URL.description: OAuth token URL based on your region (e.g., https://na.uemauth.vmwservices.com/connect/token)

WS1_UEM_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth client secret for OAuth authentication
